name: contract-runner-discovery
goal: Discover exact runner case identities and inherited disabled state without inventing group tests

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Discovery treats describe.skip as a case and loses suite-qualified identities. Nested cases can falsely count as enabled coverage or collide across suites.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing scan case covered aliases, direct skips and computed registrations only. Strengthened that same case with active and skipped nested describes; suite remains two tests.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red proof fails the strengthened existing scan case: nested names are unqualified and describe.skip is incorrectly emitted as a case. Two test declarations remain unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Leaf registrations retain suite-qualified titles and inherited disabled/dynamic flags; group registrations are not invented as tests. The unchanged two-case suite and focused lint pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
